label: Which bank an access hits
subgoals: Add the offset to the loop index for the element
Reduce the element index modulo the number of banks
Group the accesses by bank using the offsets modulo B

label: The busiest bank
subgoals: Count the accesses that fall in each bank
Take the largest count as the busiest bank's load
Choose the factor that spreads the residues of the offsets evenly

label: From conflicts to II
subgoals: Divide the busiest bank's load by its ports and round up
Read the result as a lower bound on the II
Change the factor or reuse values in registers to lower it
